title: SCPN Tokamak Core
description: Governed device-family repository for conventional and spherical tokamak configurations within the SCPN Reactor Systems Research Group. Evidence maturity computational_prototype: a validated device configuration model, diagnostic and clock semantics aligned with the SCPN Phase Orchestrator observability catalogue, level-0 device physics closed forms, and tessellated and B-rep geometry models of a cylindrical periodic equivalent. All parameter sets are synthetic; no real machine is described, and the claim inventory is empty.
